steps.text: Pepe opens her eyes and sees Zubayr's sistrum, inches away from breaking her neck in half.
Meanwhile, her hammer is pressed against Zubayr's chest, leaving a long crack in the gem on his chest.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Congratulations, Pepe...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: You did it.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I could never beat my big sister when we played hide-and-seek. Some things never change, even after so many centuries.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: The gem on your chest...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: This time... I think it's beyond repair.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: What will happen to you if it's completely shattered?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Eternal peace.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: You'll die.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Yes... I will.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: As your ancestor, may I ask a favor of you, Pepe?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: What favor?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Can you take me into that gem?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: It's hollow? I thought it was just decorative.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: No, there is something there that belongs to me, and me alone.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Thanks to them, I could say that all the years I spent guarding this place were not entirely for the sake of others.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Some of those days belonged to me.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I'll help you up...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Careful, Pepe, this vessel is heavy. But I'll be free of it soon.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Yes, stand beneath it.
Pepe helps Zubayr into the middle of the hall, underneath the massive gem.
Light and shadows dance, as the massive gem draws all the illumination in the room towards its base, converging at its tip.
Though it should be blinding, Pepe feels like she is being wrapped in warm, gentle currents.
I see it, young Nightzmora. This is your own dream.
Go forward.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: This feels familiar... as if the beckbeast is stepping on my head again.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: —Hmm?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Hey, Anat, where am I? Aspasia, do you hear me?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: ...Should have known. The comm's broken.
She sits up underneath a black beckbeast statue. The sound of water flowing echoes through the empty hall.
A massive crystal hangs from the dome, and its light reveals numerous images of people, like reflections in water.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Isn't that the shadow I was chasing by the river the other night?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Are these shadows what the people of the city see, year after year?
One of the figures stops before her.
Narantuya seems to recognize the red hair, and the haughty demeanor of the figure looking down at her.
The figure turns around and walks through a closed door at the end of the hall.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Your hair's pretty red, but I had to see your back to guess that you may be someone I knew.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: After all, the Nightzmora I know all run hard on their paths, never stopping to turn around.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: What do they say? 'May those who need them find them as its waters rise.' You're the shadows that only appear when the river rises, aren't you?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Well, I need to find the leak right now. I'll count on you this once.
The floor trembles, and the sound of falling water grows louder.
Narantuya steps through the flooded hall, running towards the armored figure.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: This is—
On the other side of the door is neither another maze passage nor flowing sand.
Through a crack in the door, she could see treasures piled up like a mountain, glowing with a radiance that a thousand years could not dull.
But she does not even have time to exclaim.
A massive fissure appears on the floor and the entire underground structure of the city trembles violently.
The hiss of rapidly flowing sand is louder than ever. Beneath the city and right under her feet, a colossal vortex of quicksand forms.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: ...Come on, that's the 'leak' I'm supposed to plug?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I never thought the insides of this large gem would be anything like this.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Do you see the platform in the middle? It may be hard to see, but it's there in the center.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: It's dazzling, but I should be able to feel my way...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: No chance I was going to see that step...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Be careful... there are three more.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I found the platform. There is a gem on it. What do I do next?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Could you take the gem from the platform and put it inside me?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Water is seeping in...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: The structural integrity of the trove has been compromised by quicksand. River water is gushing in.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: That means this place will soon be submerged.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: The river will wash away all... place the gem in my chest.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: What does the last gem represent?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Emotions. It is my emotions.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: The centuries of solitude proved too hard to endure, and I had to part ways with most of my emotions.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Your gem is broken. Putting this in won't help.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I know. I just want to depart from this realm as a human.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: You have always been human.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Ah... Thank you...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: About the City of Gold... there was something that I wanted to tell you...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Go on...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: ...Never mind.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Zubayr...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Let go, Pepe.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: You must let me go.
As the water rises above Zubayr's face, the broken gem in his chest is shattered and washed away by the surging current.
His chest grows empty, but his eyes are filled with contentment.
He closes his eyes and sinks into the water with a smile on his face.
Pepe holds him by his shoulder, feeling him grow lighter. She realizes that it is not the water that's making him lighter.
Golden liquid flows through the gaps in her fingers. It is Zubayr's body, melting away in the water.
She instinctively tries to grab Zubayr, but what is left of his shoulder dissipates at the force.
Before long, Pepe alone remains in the water, watching as the golden current flows into the distance, carrying white lotus flowers.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: May you guide his soul to rest, Horakhet.
Water pours down.
Narantuya remembers trying to catch an entire rain with the bottles in her pack when she was little.

Later, she learned that rain and drought are simply part of the cycle of life. Her tribe migrates with the weather atop their burdenbeasts; they cannot, and need not, carry so much water in their bags.

Another tremor sends the structure beneath her feet close to collapsing. Beyond the sturdy door of the trove, gold coins clatter against each other, their alluring clinks echoing the sound of her dreams.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Wish I could tell those two kitties in the museum that a hole big enough to sink a city isn't going to be plugged by a few planks.
Narantuya remembers how she dreamed about it.
If she truly owned a mountain of gold—real gold, not the gilded iron ingots that the lords ameer smelt, or the empty checks they write—the first thing she would do is dance on top of it.
That way, all the treasure will be captivated by her, and never leave her again.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Well then, let's dance.
Narantuya backs off a little bit and lifts a black beckbeast statue.
Then, she charges at the seemingly indestructible door.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Open up—!
Slowly, the door opens to her shout, and she glimpses a corner of the mountain of gold through the gap.
The mountain of gold begins to collapse as the structure tilts further and further.
Treasures beyond reckoning spill out, further widening the fissure as they crash onto the floor.
Water crashing down from above mixes with gold and sand, distorting the walls under its pressure and turning the massive treasure pile into a glittering waterfall.
The Nightzmora nimbly throws her knife and grabs onto the rope attached.
Like an elegant dancer, she swings through the air, watching as the mountain of gold cascades into the shimmering deluge.
She throws her head back and laughs.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: It's not quite how I envisioned it... but I knew I wasn't delusional!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I really made it to the City of Radiance and struck gold!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Honestly, how many in all of Sargon's history have enough gold to make it rain like a waterfall?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I'll remember this sea of gold. Just as I'll remember that what I desire, I shall have.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I'll amass more gold, then I'll make it rain once more.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: When that day comes, the deserts of Sargon will remember my name!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: This—is my choice!
The glittering begins to dim as the gold falls through the fissure and into the vortex.
The roiling sands begin to calm. The sunken treasure has filled the fissure, staunching the quicksand.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: *Sargon swearing* Wait a minute.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: One less piece of treasure or two wouldn't have made a difference, right?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Why didn't I at least take one home?
Goodbye, Zubayr.
...Huh, so the trove collapsed when its guardian died. Makes sense.
So where am I?
And how am I supposed to swim myself out when you've gone with the water?
Water presses at her chest, rising above her eyes, still gently whirling, dragging her ever deeper.
She feels everything grow dark around her.
Then, someone grabs her hand.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Thank...)
Guess luck is on my side after all!
One last piece of treasure to take home!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: H-Has it stopped?

steps.name: Ajazi
steps.text: Yes, Curator Anat. Sand isn't coming out of the taps anymore.

steps.name: Ajani
steps.text: Neither is water.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Maybe it's just clogged? Maybe things—

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Don't worry. The jewel constructs have stopped moving.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: No sign of energy from the Originium circuits... it may never wake up again.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: You were carrying that little pet of yours?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I trust Pepe.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Well, we've done what we could...

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: The chaos in the city has indeed stopped, but we can't be sure if it's over for good.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Yes. We are still anxious.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: ...We all owe your friend a great debt of gratitude.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: I promise that I will honor her deeds and Pepe's in my report, that their names will be known throughout the City of Radiance, and immortalized in the history books for posterity...
I don't mind being known throughout the city, but I'd rather not be immortalized in the history books until I'm actually dead.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Narantuya?!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Hey, give me a hand with this girl here.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: ...Pepe?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: She probably would've been done for if I hadn't come across her while swimming out.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I kept swimming up and ended up here.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: You look awful...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Where's Zubayr...?
Pepe turns her gaze to the pool next to her.
May you guide his soul to rest, Horakhet.
Let time flow for him again. Let us all move forward once more.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Hey! I almost drowned. Of course my face and lips are going to be a little blue.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Never mind that. Let me see my accomplishments! The sand's gone from the city, right? And the water's clean now?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: R-Right now?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: How did you get your face so dirty when you've been inside the museum all this time? Come, let's wash away that dirt!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: N-No! Not getting wet from the rain is the main reason why I don't do field work!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Looks like I saved quite a few lives today.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: But I guess none of these kitties are competent enough to be my subordinate.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: What does a competent subordinate look like in the mind of that Kuranta?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Ajani
steps.text: See, I told you Narantuya would be fine! She wouldn't have just left us here.

steps.name: Ajazi
steps.text: Sit down, Ajani.

steps.name: Ajazi
steps.text: The fountain's shaky and it'll fall over if we both stand up at the same time. It's my turn to stand up now.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: ...Perhaps someone who fears nothing, like herself.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: You too, Titi!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: It's such a fine and sunny day, isn't it?
